name: Tomasa Tassara — birth about 1864, Buenos Aires, Argentina
researcher_question: When and where was Tomasa Tassara born, the wife of Juan Rossello and mother of Juan Felipe Marcelo (christened 15 August 1885), Angela (born 31 July 1889) and Maria (christened 25 February 1899) Rossello at Mercedes, Buenos Aires, Argentina?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 33, hint-samples.csv row 13, flag adds_birth, confidence 3). Resolved OUTCOME 1 (true match). The hint (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-LBB, Argentina censo nacional 1895) is Tomasa Tassara, married, Birth 1864 Buenos Aires, Cuartel 01 (Poblacion rural) Mercedes -- the wife of tree person GW82-2VP. image_basis true: the index does not group the household (each member has its own 1:2 record), so identity rests on reading the census register image (ark:/61903/3:1:S3HY-674Q-DT3), which enumerates Tomasa (age 31 -> b.~1864, married) immediately after husband Juan Rossello (age 37, Italy) with children Juan (9), Catalina (7), Angela (5) and Bartolome (3) as one consecutive household. Step 1a calibration passed on two other entries on the same image -- Andres Ballestrero (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-L19, b.1830/age 65) and Pedro Ratti the son (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-L1Q, b.1884/age 11). Disclosed discrepancy: a third entry, Pedro Ratti the father (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-L1W), is indexed b.1835 (age 60) but the OCR read his age as 40 -- a probable handwritten 6-vs-4 digit misread, immaterial to this adjudication (a control, not the subject; identity rests on independently-indexed names/place/children's ages). Birth kept at 'about 1864' (age-derived) and birthplace at 'Buenos Aires, Argentina' (province or city -- census column F reads 'Bs Aires'); not sharpened to the city or an exact year. Corroborated by the indexed household: Juan Rossello MW49-LBT, children MW49-LB5/LBY/LB1/LBR; Maria (tree b.1898) correctly absent.
